note: The digging zombies of the waves (docs/rl/ZOMBIES-DIG.md): the tools of a zombie's hand, the tiers (a kind of zombie with a tool, its share of the wave's zombies by the wave), the numbers of the breaking and the hearing. ZombieDig.java has the same built in (ZombieDigTest checks them against this file); tools/rl/zdig.py reads it for the two simulators. A block: ticks = max(min_ticks, ceil(hardness * 30 / speed * slow)), speed of the tool on what it is for (a shovel soil, an axe wood, a pickaxe rock) else 1; a block that wants a tool is broken only by the right tool of the level (stone 0, iron ore 1, diamond and gold ore 2, obsidian 3), bedrock by none; over max_ticks never.

tiers.name: digger
tiers.digs: soil by hand, stone, coal, iron ore

tiers.name: miner
tiers.digs: the same faster, gold, redstone, diamond ore
